		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 14.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 15.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = maize_farmstead }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 15.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 16.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = maize_rotations }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 16.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 17.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = maize_model_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 17.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 18.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = legume_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 18.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 19.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = legume_farmstead }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 19.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 20.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = legume_rotations }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 20.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 21.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = legume_model_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 21.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 22.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = potato_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 22.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 23.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = potato_farmstead }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 23.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 24.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = potato_rotations }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 24.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 25.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = potato_model_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 25.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 26.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = olive_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 26.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 27.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = olive_farmstead }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 27.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 28.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = olive_rotations }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 28.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 29.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = olive_model_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 29.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 30.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = cattle_farm }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 30.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 31.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = cattle_farmstead }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 31.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 32.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = cattle_rotations }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:pp_cplan_pick > 32.5 var:pp_cplan_pick < 33.5 }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = cattle_model_farm }
	}
	remove_variable = pp_cplan_best
	remove_variable = pp_cplan_pick
}

# Location scope (the province capital): a kitchen level (the province's Cookshop budget is its max level), first that can be built.
pp_cplan_try_kitchen_here = {
	if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = public_kitchen } }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = public_kitchen }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = cookshop } }
		pp_cplan_construct_food = { type = cookshop }
	}
}

# Location scope (the province capital): a Tavern level, first that can be built.

# Location scope: the first logistics building that can be built here ([construction_plan] logistics_order).
pp_cplan_try_logistics_here = {
	if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = river_boatmen_yard } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = river_boatmen_yard why = 102 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = coastal_shipping_office } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = coastal_shipping_office why = 102 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = transport_office } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = transport_office why = 102 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = carrier_inn } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = carrier_inn why = 102 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = pp_caravanserai } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = pp_caravanserai why = 102 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = pp_oasis_caravan_station } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = pp_oasis_caravan_station why = 102 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = pp_yam_station } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = pp_yam_station why = 102 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = pp_banjara_tanda } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = pp_banjara_tanda why = 102 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = pp_llama_caravan_post } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = pp_llama_caravan_post why = 102 }
	}
}

# ---- Goods ----

# Location scope: a producer of camels, a standing one first.
pp_cplan_try_goods_camels = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:camel_herders location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = camel_herders } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = camel_herders why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_type:camel_stud location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = camel_stud } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = camel_stud why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = camel_herders } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = camel_herders why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = camel_stud } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = camel_stud why = 103 }
	}
}
# Location scope: one more level of a standing camels producer that earns.
pp_cplan_expand_goods_camels = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:camel_herders building_profit > 0 is_at_max_level = no }
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = camel_herders }
		}
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = camel_herders why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			any_buildings_in_location = { building_type = building_type:camel_stud building_profit > 0 is_at_max_level = no }
			location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = camel_stud }
		}
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = camel_stud why = 103 }
	}
}

		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = tobacco_farm } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = tobacco_farm why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = tobacco_plantation } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = tobacco_plantation why = 103 }
	}
}

	else_if = {

		pp_cplan_construct = { type = brewery_mill why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = beer_workshop } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = beer_workshop why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = brewery } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = brewery why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = brewery_manufactory } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = brewery_manufactory why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = brewery_mill } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = brewery_mill why = 103 }
	}
}

		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = furniture_guild } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = furniture_guild why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = furniture_manufactory } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = furniture_manufactory why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = furniture_mill } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = furniture_mill why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = furniture_workshop } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = furniture_workshop why = 103 }
	}
}

		pp_cplan_construct = { type = textile_mill why = 103 }

	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = cloth_guild } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = cloth_guild why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_and_owner_can_build = { building_type = cloth_manufactory } }
		pp_cplan_construct = { type = cloth_manufactory why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {

		pp_cplan_construct = { type = cloth_workshop why = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {

	else_if = {

	}

# Country scope (scope:pp_cplan_country): one construction per good and month at most, while the budget lasts.
pp_cplan_goods_run = {
	# camels
	if = {
		limit = { pp_cplan_mode_camels > 0.5 pp_cplan_mode_camels < 1.5 pp_cplan_budget_left = yes }
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_hit
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_location_ok = yes pp_cplan_months_camels < scope:pp_cplan_country.pp_cplan_keep_months }
			order_by = pp_cplan_site_camels
			max = 30
			check_range_bounds = no
			if = {
				limit = { pp_cplan_may_try = yes }
				pp_cplan_try_goods_camels = yes
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { pp_cplan_mode_camels > 1.5 pp_cplan_mode_camels < 2.5 pp_cplan_budget_left = yes }
		remove_variable = pp_cplan_hit
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = { pp_cplan_location_ok = yes pp_cplan_has_earner_camels = yes }
			order_by = pp_cplan_site_camels
			max = 30
			check_range_bounds = no
			if = {
				limit = { pp_cplan_may_try = yes }
				pp_cplan_expand_goods_camels = yes
			}
		}
	}

# Country scope: sets the mode of the good named by the flag scope:pp_good to the flag scope:pp_mode
# (off / keep / expand / never). Called by the scripted GUI pp_cplan_good_mode.
pp_cplan_set_good_mode = {
	switch = {
		trigger = scope:pp_good
		flag:camels = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_camels } }
		flag:elephants = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_elephants } }
		flag:horses = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_horses } }
		flag:livestock = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_livestock } }
		flag:wool = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_wool } }
		flag:beeswax = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_beeswax } }
		flag:dyes = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_dyes } }
		flag:incense = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_incense } }
		flag:tobacco = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_tobacco } }
		flag:cotton = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_cotton } }
		flag:fiber_crops = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_fiber_crops } }
		flag:silk = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_silk } }
		flag:chili = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_chili } }
		flag:cloves = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_cloves } }
		flag:pepper = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_pepper } }
		flag:saffron = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_saffron } }
		flag:legumes = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_legumes } }
		flag:maize = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_maize } }
		flag:millet = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_millet } }
		flag:potato = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_potato } }
		flag:rice = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_rice } }
		flag:wheat = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_wheat } }
		flag:cocoa = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_cocoa } }
		flag:coffee = { pp_cplan_apply_mode = { var = pp_cplan_g_coffee } }

# Any scope, never run (pp_cplan_run calls it under always = no): declares the flags the panel passes, so the
# script check logs no 'used but never set' line for them.
